061910.summary: Unresolved Argyle source disagreement: the BRB fiscal 2025 series reports principal $670,626,909, interest $554,498,697 and total $1,225,125,606, with a last positive scheduled balance in 2056. Argyle's debt-obligations HTML labeled August 31, 2025 reports total $1,225,069,254; its FY2025 HB1378 PDF reports $1,273,804,555 and final maturity August 15, 2057. The continuing-disclosure filing dated February 26, 2026 reports principal as of February 15, 2026 and Table 11 payments through FY2057 totaling $1,273,804,554.70. Principal agrees to the nearest dollar, but dates, coverage and interest assumptions have not been reconciled; none of these figures replaces another.
061910.comparability: Not established. Fiscal-period labels, principal as-of dates, balance years and payment years are distinct. No issuer-level reconciliation of variable-rate interest or issue coverage has been completed.
